create_ContextParallelConfig: create a ContextParallelConfig with ring_degree and ulysses_degree for context parallel inference
setup_ParallelConfig: setup a ParallelConfig with rank, world size, device, and optional mesh for distributed training
create_ContextParallelInput: create a ContextParallelInput to split tensors along a specified dimension across context parallel region

run_gather_size_by_comm: run gather_size_by_comm to collect local sizes from all ranks in a distributed process group
